The exact activation and completion responses are saved as [native-goal-active.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F01-A1/run/A-F01-A1/stages/reviser/native-goal-active.json) and [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F01-A1/run/A-F01-A1/stages/reviser/native-goal-terminal.json). Primary-source rechecks are recorded in the map, including [CouchDB conflict behavior](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/replication/conflicts.html), [SQLite crash-test and durability caveats](https://sqlite.org/atomiccommit.html), and the [PouchDB attachment fix](https://github.com/apache/pouchdb/pull/8460/files). No application code or tests were run; the validation matrix is proposed work only.
